prompt: A long straight terraced street at night with snow on the ground: a burning oil drum every twenty metres down the middle of the road, each one with a ring of adults in coats and blankets round it holding out their hands, the houses behind all dark. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
